text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... you two have just been standing
there... do
you need something?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: L-like I said, it's not your fault!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... did you... wrong me somehow?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... Rice and I made a picture
book, as a
birthday present for you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It had a nice story about you riding a
black cat
and finding legendary coffee
beans. But right as
we were about to
bind the book...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The last page went missing! We looked

everywhere but couldn't find it... Sorry,
it's all my
fault!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...That's okay. A picture book without an
ending...
sounds nice, actually.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
From what I can tell... it's the things we
can't see
that stir our imaginations the
most...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So a missing last page... could make the
story
even more compelling...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What I mean to say is... Thank you. I...
appreciate
your gift.
